title: David Licauco, Ashtine Olviga step up to the challenge in PH's ‘Fight for My Way’

blocks.text: David Licauco and Ashtine Olviga are stepping up to the challenge of portraying the lead roles in the Filipino adaptation of the hit Korean drama “Fight for My Way.” Licauco and Olviga will play Hanz and Aira, respectively, in the upcoming Viva One series, which marks the streaming platform’s first-ever Korean series adaptation. During the series’ press conference on Monday, Sept. 28, Licauco admitted feeling pressure over taking on roles from a popular K-drama. “Of course, I’m really grateful for the opportunity.
